entryPointCandidates.name: CornerCV6.jsx
entryPointCandidates.summary: Root entry component for the CV6 dashboard surface that /dashboard now renders; mounts every screen (Home, Chat, Support, Command, Tracker, LiveScribe, Search) as a fill-in template fed real data, with a view-machine router and demo fixtures.

entryPointCandidates.name: ChatDesktop.jsx
entryPointCandidates.summary: Desktop CV6 chat surface: three-pane layout with room/project navigation, a files shelf, and the message thread, backed by room-library aggregation and agent-control actions (handoff, pause, retask).

entryPointCandidates.name: Organize.jsx
entryPointCandidates.summary: Viewport router for the CV6 Organize tool; mounts OrganizeDesktop or OrganizeMobile based on a max-width:899px media query and forwards nav/search/assign props.

entryPointCandidates.name: Onboarding.jsx
entryPointCandidates.summary: Responsive router for the CV6 first-run onboarding flow; mounts OnboardingDesktop or OnboardingMobile based on a viewport media query.

entryPointCandidates.name: ReviewDesktop.jsx
entryPointCandidates.summary: Desktop layout for the Review tool that binds the useReview queue to the wired template and wires deliverable viewing, pin comments, request-changes overlay, and the tree context menu.

documentation.name: chat-list.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Chat list screen: an Agents section (avatar, live status dot, last-message snippet, needs-you count) and a Projects section (folder glyph, rollup status), with All/Agents/Projects/Needs-you filter chips; tapping a row opens the Goal Thread.

documentation.name: chat.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the Chat / Goal Thread tool in both desktop (rooms rail, conversation thread, agent control drawer) and mobile layouts; the thread's step blocks (done, snag+decision, working, upcoming) compose from the shared agent-chat kit.

documentation.name: command.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the Command tool: a goal ledger of every room's current goal, a background-activity dock aggregating running jobs, and a goal-detail panel that drives the master-loop (checklist, scheduled loops, master-loop watch); desktop + mobile.

documentation.name: home-desktop.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the desktop Home surface (now two columns): an All Rooms rail with the agents/recently-active/projects-and-missions tree, plus the selected room's Conversation column; anchors the shared room/agent/mission vocabulary reused across every CV6 screen.

documentation.name: home-mobile.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Home surface across two navigation states: (A) Pick-up-where-you-left-off + All Rooms, and (B) a project opened to its general chat and mission list; shares the desktop Home room/mission data vocabulary.

documentation.name: kit.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup and reference kit for the agent-chat element vocabulary, labeled once: turn anatomy (avatar + stacked typed blocks), communication blocks (success / question / snag), data outputs and more, meant to be wired once and reused across Chat, Support, Command, and Live Scribe.

documentation.name: livescribe.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the Live Scribe tool: a live-capture surface with recording timer, animated waveform, and a start/stop capture button plus transcript turns; desktop and mobile screens.

documentation.name: onboarding.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the guided first-run Onboarding flow through the Settings 'Environment' surface (connect sources → agents & permissions → theme → first goal → Home); desktop split layout plus mobile, with step content that swaps by current step.

documentation.name: organize.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the Organize file tool: desktop project-tree → file-list → file-preview layout, and mobile browse+multi-select with a Move/Rename/Share/Delete action bar, a move-to-folder sheet, and a file view/review screen.

documentation.name: review.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the Review tool: a deliverable queue (project→mission tree over the scoped deliverable list), a deliverable viewer with pin-comments, and an approve / request-changes decision panel; the viewer swaps by deliverable type (doc/photo/video/siteshot/sitelive), with the document viewer shown as canonical.

documentation.name: settings.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the Settings 'Environment' master surface: the connections list (email and other sources agents can act on), rooms & scope controls, and shared-room awareness messaging that governs which rooms and people can reach each connection.

documentation.name: states-extra.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the shared empty / loading / error state fragment reused by every CV6 tool; the same markup carries tool-specific copy through data-bind and is shown by swapping which data-state block renders, so tools never redraw these states themselves.

documentation.name: support-inbox.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Support inbox: a list of incoming emails/asks with avatar tints, status chips, and filter chips, delivered as the shippable device-content fragment (specimen framing and fake status bar stripped).

documentation.name: support-thread.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Support email-thread view: the real original email (sender, body, time) bound from the tapped inbox item, an agent-summary card that shows real bullets or plainly states why not (pending/failed/needs-assign), expandable quoted history, and a reply-via-agent action held until the email becomes an ask.

documentation.name: tracker.html
documentation.summary: Static design mockup for the Tracker (bug) tool: desktop tracker switcher, bug table, and bug detail; mobile A) bug list with attachments and a live-agent strip, B) bug detail with assign-to-agent, and C) an agent-working-live view.

config.name: chat-list.json
config.summary: Data-binding contract for the mobile chat-list screen, declaring the live/needs-you counts, the agent row shape (id, name, initials, tint, status), actions, states, and modifier rules the wired template fills with real data.

config.name: chat.json
config.summary: Data-binding contract for the Chat Goal Thread tool across desktop and mobile, composing message blocks from the agent-chat kit and defining the rooms/agents/goal vocabulary, actions, and states the thread renders.

config.name: command.json
config.summary: Data-binding contract for the Command tool screen, describing the goal ledger, background-activity dock, and focused goal-detail regions plus their counts, actions, and states.

config.name: home-desktop.json
config.summary: Data-binding contract for the desktop Home screen, shaped to useHomeData: it declares the agents, projects, needs-you catch-up inbox, and conversation/goal column field shapes, actions, states, and responsive modifiers.

config.name: home-mobile.json
config.summary: Data-binding contract for the mobile Home screen, sharing the desktop Home rooms/agents/projects vocabulary and declaring the mobile-specific data shapes, actions, and states its wired template renders.

config.name: kit.json
config.summary: Element-kit contract for the shared agent-chat vocabulary, defining the reusable turn/message/block templates (avatar, status, stacked blocks, user reply bubble) cloned across Chat, Support, Command, and Live Scribe.

config.name: support-inbox.json
config.summary: Data-binding contract for the Support inbox tool, declaring the thread list, message shapes, tint enums, actions, states, and shared rules that useSupportInbox fills with the real support flow data.

config.name: tracker.json
config.summary: Data-binding contract for the Tracker tool (CV6 bug tracker), describing the desktop switcher/bug-table/detail regions and the mobile list, switch, and detail states with their bug row shapes and actions.

list.name: Root & Navigation
list.description: The CV6 root view-machine (CornerCV6) that routes to every screen, the shared responsive nav rail, and the persistent live-agent activity dock mounted in the shell.

list.name: Screen Views
list.description: Responsive screen components — Onboarding, Organize, Review, Settings, Support, Campaign, LiveScribe, Search and their router/Desktop/Mobile triads plus review-pin and tree-context overlays.

list.name: Chat & Messaging
list.description: The chat feature cluster: desktop/mobile chat orchestrators, goal-thread and block renderers, message thread and attachment views, composers, and result-link cards.

list.name: Data Hooks & State
list.description: The view-model wiring layer — use* React hooks, the shared DataContext provider, and document/media/link helper modules that feed real data and demo fixtures to the screens.

list.name: Seed & Contract Data
list.description: Static JSON UI-contract and seed files under data/ that define binding shapes and sample content for each screen (chat, home, command, tracker, support, kit).

list.name: Design Templates
list.description: Static HTML design mockups under templates/ — one reference per screen — that document the intended visual design and are not runtime code.

list.name: Styling & Design Tokens
list.description: The cv6.css stylesheet holding the CV6 design-token system, theming variables, and shared component styles imported by the shell.

file:ActivityDock.jsx.name: ActivityDock.jsx
file:ActivityDock.jsx.summary: Floating background-activity dock that mounts in the CornerCV6 shell and follows across every screen, showing live Claude agent sessions from /api/dashboard/active-agents with a sample fallback when idle.

file:CornerCV6.jsx.name: CornerCV6.jsx
file:CornerCV6.jsx.summary: Root entry component for the CV6 dashboard surface that /dashboard now renders; mounts every screen (Home, Chat, Support, Command, Tracker, LiveScribe, Search) as a fill-in template fed real data, with a view-machine router and demo fixtures.

file:LiveScribe.jsx.name: LiveScribe.jsx
file:LiveScribe.jsx.summary: Live Scribe meeting-capture tool screen (the 8th nav tool), grafted from the design-system livescribe template and driven by the useLiveScribe hook for real 15s-chunk audio recording and Gemini transcription.

file:NewComposer.jsx.name: NewComposer.jsx
file:NewComposer.jsx.summary: The single start-a-mission / new-project creation overlay for the whole surface, opened from every entry point (Home and Organize on both breakpoints) and hitting createMissionInProject / createProjectFromHome.

file:Search.jsx.name: Search.jsx
file:Search.jsx.summary: Global command-K search (mobile field + desktop palette) built in React because it is input-driven; filters Rooms and Missions client-side from the same hooks Home and Chat use and opens the selected room.

file:SharedNav.jsx.name: SharedNav.jsx
file:SharedNav.jsx.summary: The one canonical navigation, rendered as a desktop tool bar and a mobile drawer that both read the same ordered NAV_TOOLS list so icons, order, and active state never drift between screens.

file:SupportDesktop.jsx.name: SupportDesktop.jsx
file:SupportDesktop.jsx.summary: Desktop Support screen: an Open/Waiting inbox rail plus an email-review pane with AI summary, original email, suggested actions, and a reply composer, where every control is wired to a real backend (send-staged, reply, resolve, tracker, assign).

file:SupportThread.jsx.name: SupportThread.jsx
file:SupportThread.jsx.summary: Conversation card rendering the real Gmail chain behind one support ask from /api/support/thread — every inbound and outbound message in order, latest expanded and earlier ones collapsed, with a single-message fallback when no thread exists.

file:data/agentTitles.js.name: agentTitles.js
file:data/agentTitles.js.summary: Central agent-privacy map: exposes agents as role titles rather than persona names everywhere (roster, Catch Up feed, headers), via the AGENT_TITLES slug-to-title map and the ordered DASHBOARD_AGENTS set.

file:data/blockSchema.js.name: blockSchema.js
file:data/blockSchema.js.summary: Defines the CV6 chat message block schema: the BLOCK_TYPES catalog (step, success, snag, question, data, summary, code, choice, gallery, etc.) plus small factory helpers to build each block, layered additively on top of a message's plain text.

file:data/resultLinks.js.name: resultLinks.js
file:data/resultLinks.js.summary: Decides which links in an agent message deserve a tappable card, pulling from the structured completion payload first and then any http(s) URL in the agent's text so completed web work always lands as a card rather than a bare URL.

file:data/useCommandTracker.js.name: useCommandTracker.js
file:data/useCommandTracker.js.summary: Provides the real data hooks behind the Command screen (live agent activity dock + 24h room ledger via useCommand) and the Tracker screen (the real CV6 bug list via useTrackerBugs), with no fabricated data.

file:data/useDemoBlocks.js.name: useDemoBlocks.js
file:data/useDemoBlocks.js.summary: Demo block feed for exercising CV6 chat block rendering, assembling a clearly-labelled DEMO stream from the blockSchema factories, activated via ?demo=blocks so it can never be mistaken for real data.

file:data/useHomeData.js.name: useHomeData.js
file:data/useHomeData.js.summary: Shapes the real Home-screen data (agents, projects, the needs-you Catch Up) from the shared useDataPipe context into the Home fill-in templates, and exposes chat-list, project-mission, and creation helpers used across the surface.

file:data/useLiveScribe.js.name: useLiveScribe.js
file:data/useLiveScribe.js.summary: Live Scribe capture hook that records audio in 15-second chunks, transcribes each via Gemini, extracts action items and decisions every third chunk, and saves the finished session to cm_state, reporting template-friendly state.

file:data/useRoomThread.js.name: useRoomThread.js
file:data/useRoomThread.js.summary: Shapes one room's real conversation from /api/dashboard/supabase-messages into the agent-chat Turn contract (oldest to newest), and exposes goal-thread and room-plan hooks plus work-step-to-block injection for the chat surface.

file:data/useSupportInbox.js.name: useSupportInbox.js
file:data/useSupportInbox.js.summary: Wires the real support flow into the { state, data } contract the support-inbox template expects, filtering out no-reply senders and reporting loading/empty/error honestly instead of faking rows.

file:providers/DataContext.jsx.name: DataContext.jsx
file:providers/DataContext.jsx.summary: Single shared data source for the whole dashboard: one DataProvider wraps useDataPipe at the top level and one CommandProvider wraps useCommand/useTrackerBugs, collapsing 6+ redundant polling loops and Supabase subscriptions into one and adding client-side caching.

file:Organize.jsx.name: Organize.jsx
file:Organize.jsx.summary: Viewport router for the CV6 Organize tool; mounts OrganizeDesktop or OrganizeMobile based on a max-width:899px media query and forwards nav/search/assign props.

file:OrganizeDesktop.jsx.name: OrganizeDesktop.jsx
file:OrganizeDesktop.jsx.summary: Desktop layout for the Organize tool that binds the useOrganize data hook to the wired template, wiring the file tree, doc/media viewers, pins, review-changes overlay, and tree context menu.

file:OrganizeMobile.jsx.name: OrganizeMobile.jsx
file:OrganizeMobile.jsx.summary: Mobile layout for the Organize tool with picker/browse/view screens; composes each screen from the useOrganize data and reuses the desktop viewers, pins, and composer.

file:Review.jsx.name: Review.jsx
file:Review.jsx.summary: Mobile/compact Review tool screen that composes the deliverables review queue from the useReview hook and wires approve, request-changes, and pin-comment interactions.

file:ReviewChanges.jsx.name: ReviewChanges.jsx
file:ReviewChanges.jsx.summary: Overlay that compiles a reviewer's requested changes (comments and pins) into a single change list before it is sent back to the agent as a decision event.

file:ReviewDesktop.jsx.name: ReviewDesktop.jsx
file:ReviewDesktop.jsx.summary: Desktop layout for the Review tool that binds the useReview queue to the wired template and wires deliverable viewing, pin comments, request-changes overlay, and the tree context menu.

file:ReviewPins.jsx.name: ReviewPins.jsx
file:ReviewPins.jsx.summary: Pin-comment UI layer for the Review viewer; provides the useReviewPinUI hook and a PinPopover portal for placing point comments on docs, images, and video frames.

file:TreeContextMenu.jsx.name: TreeContextMenu.jsx
file:TreeContextMenu.jsx.summary: Right-click / long-press context menu shared by Home, Organize, and Review project/mission rows; exposes the useTreeContextMenu hook plus rename, move, archive, and create node actions against the dashboard API.

file:data/docxDocView.js.name: docxDocView.js
file:data/docxDocView.js.summary: Docx preview helper for Organize/Review viewers; renders a shell, sanitizes converted HTML, and provides the useDocxDocs hook that hydrates .docx nodes in the wrapper.

file:data/htmlDocView.js.name: htmlDocView.js
file:data/htmlDocView.js.summary: HTML file preview helper that rewrites relative asset URLs and CSS references for safe in-viewer rendering and provides the useHtmlDocs hook to hydrate .html preview nodes.

file:data/mediaFallback.js.name: mediaFallback.js
file:data/mediaFallback.js.summary: Installs a single global media-error handler that swaps a failed video/audio/img element in place for a 'Couldn't load / Retry' card with a cache-busted retry, shared by Organize and Review previews.

file:data/pdfDocView.js.name: pdfDocView.js
file:data/pdfDocView.js.summary: PDF preview helper that renders a viewer shell and provides the usePdfDocs hook to hydrate and dispose PDF preview nodes in the Organize/Review wrappers.

file:data/useOrganize.js.name: useOrganize.js
file:data/useOrganize.js.summary: Core Organize data hook that reads the project_files disk mirror metadata, lazily fetches and previews file content (markdown, images, PDFs, media), and shapes it to the wired Organize template contract.

file:data/usePins.js.name: usePins.js
file:data/usePins.js.summary: Hook managing pin-comment state for the Review tool, persisting point comments (x/y fractions plus optional video time) to the review-comments API so they survive refresh and reach the agent's fix-list.

file:data/useReview.js.name: useReview.js
file:data/useReview.js.summary: Core Review data hook that loads the real deliverables queue from the review-queue API, builds each deliverable's rendered body, groups sequences, and wires approve / request-changes as real decision events.

file:BlockRenderer.jsx.name: BlockRenderer.jsx
file:BlockRenderer.jsx.summary: Structured-block rendering library for CV6 chat: a `Result` dispatcher plus one component per agent block type (email, summary, artifact, data table, code diff, gallery, question, confirm) and shared `ActionChips`.

file:ChatDesktop.jsx.name: ChatDesktop.jsx
file:ChatDesktop.jsx.summary: Desktop CV6 chat surface: three-pane layout with room/project navigation, a files shelf, and the message thread, backed by room-library aggregation and agent-control actions (handoff, pause, retask).

file:ChatGoalThread.jsx.name: ChatGoalThread.jsx
file:ChatGoalThread.jsx.summary: The Goal Thread rendering core: turns agent blocks and live steps into a structured work timeline (step rows, work-done cards, plan panel, proposals) and re-declares the block components plus the Send/Review contexts.

file:ChatLifecycle.jsx.name: ChatLifecycle.jsx
file:ChatLifecycle.jsx.summary: Mobile/lifecycle chat orchestrator that assembles the full chat experience — day-grouped messages, goal turns, file galleries, dictation, room files sheet, and the composer — pulling renderers from the other CV6 chat modules.

file:Cv6FullComposer.jsx.name: Cv6FullComposer.jsx
file:Cv6FullComposer.jsx.summary: The full CV6 message composer: a portal-mounted input experience with attachments, recording, voice mode, and slash commands, wrapped in an error-boundary class with read-only and mini fallbacks.

file:Cv6InputBar.jsx.name: Cv6InputBar.jsx
file:Cv6InputBar.jsx.summary: The CV6 chat input bar: text field with slash-command autocomplete, image-tool and integrations pickers, paste-chip handling, and a commands menu.

file:MessageAttachments.jsx.name: MessageAttachments.jsx
file:MessageAttachments.jsx.summary: Renders message attachments — single images, image galleries with a lightbox, and file collections with download/review actions — dispatched by attachment shape.

file:MessageThread.jsx.name: MessageThread.jsx
file:MessageThread.jsx.summary: Message thread renderer for CV6: groups messages by sender, renders desktop and mobile message turns, attaches goal-thread bodies, result blocks, attachments, and link cards per message.

file:ResultLinkCard.jsx.name: ResultLinkCard.jsx
file:ResultLinkCard.jsx.summary: Small component rendering a row of link preview cards (host + label) for URLs surfaced in an agent result.

file:data/useDictation.js.name: useDictation.js
file:data/useDictation.js.summary: React hook wrapping the browser SpeechRecognition API to provide push-to-talk dictation, emitting transcribed text to a callback.

file:Onboarding.jsx.name: Onboarding.jsx
file:Onboarding.jsx.summary: Responsive router for the CV6 first-run onboarding flow; mounts OnboardingDesktop or OnboardingMobile based on a viewport media query.

file:OnboardingDesktop.jsx.name: OnboardingDesktop.jsx
file:OnboardingDesktop.jsx.summary: Desktop onboarding screen that composes the wired HTML template with loading/error/empty states and binds real onboarding data plus step-progression actions via TemplateScreen.

file:OnboardingMobile.jsx.name: OnboardingMobile.jsx
file:OnboardingMobile.jsx.summary: Mobile onboarding screen that mounts the full-width onboarding template with a step indicator and binds real data plus back/skip/next progression via TemplateScreen.

file:data/useOnboarding.js.name: useOnboarding.js
file:data/useOnboarding.js.summary: React hook backing the guided first-run onboarding flow: tracks auth, step index, and theme, and shapes the step/connection/agent/theme view model consumed by the desktop and mobile screens.

file:Settings.jsx.name: Settings.jsx
file:Settings.jsx.summary: Responsive router for the CV6 Settings screen that renders the desktop or mobile variant based on a media-query breakpoint.

file:SettingsDesktop.jsx.name: SettingsDesktop.jsx
file:SettingsDesktop.jsx.summary: Desktop variant of the CV6 Settings screen; composes the static HTML shell with live data from useSettings and wires nav, search, and theme controls.

file:SettingsMobile.jsx.name: SettingsMobile.jsx
file:SettingsMobile.jsx.summary: Mobile variant of the CV6 Settings screen with a list/detail two-view flow; composes the static HTML shell with live data from useSettings.

file:data/useSettings.js.name: useSettings.js
file:data/useSettings.js.summary: Data hook backing both Settings variants; loads the authenticated user, projects, and theme, and derives the settings view model consumed by the UI.

file:Campaign.jsx.name: Campaign.jsx
file:Campaign.jsx.summary: Mission-control screen for the Email > Campaign cold-outreach tool: a today-first dashboard combining a health strip, goal progress, pipeline stages, per-city detail, an activity feed, and a multi-step campaign creation wizard.

file:EmailShell.jsx.name: EmailShell.jsx
file:EmailShell.jsx.summary: Segmented-tab shell for the Email tool that flips between the existing Inbox (Support) surface and the Campaign mission-control tool, persisting the active tab per session in sessionStorage.

file:data/useCampaign.js.name: useCampaign.js
file:data/useCampaign.js.summary: Data-fetching React hooks (authFetch + world param + interval polling) backing the Campaign tool: list, detail, health, contacts, city detail, activity feed, and a campaign-action mutator.

document:templates/tracker.html.name: tracker.html
document:templates/tracker.html.summary: Static design mockup for the Tracker (bug) tool: desktop tracker switcher, bug table, and bug detail; mobile A) bug list with attachments and a live-agent strip, B) bug detail with assign-to-agent, and C) an agent-working-live view.

file:cv6.css.name: cv6.css
file:cv6.css.summary: The single-import CV6 stylesheet: design tokens (color scales, semantic surface/text/accent vars, radii, fonts), frame layout, and every screen-primitive class for the CV6 dashboard surface. Defines dark, light, and glass themes plus reduced-motion and per-screen variants, all scoped under [data-cv6].

file:PinLayer.jsx.name: PinLayer.jsx
file:PinLayer.jsx.summary: Interactive overlay layer for the CV6 viewer that lets users drop numbered comment pins by clicking empty space and re-open existing pins. Positioned absolutely over doc/image/video/website viewers via a crosshair-cursor wrapper.
